name: hoverbot
description: Access to one HoverBot workspace: chatbots, knowledge sources, shopper conversations, unanswered questions, analytics, plan usage, skills, captured leads and conversations handed to a person, with opt-ins to reply to those customers and to edit knowledge.

interface.longDescription:
This plugin gives ChatGPT access to one HoverBot workspace, so the people who run a support bot can ask about it in plain language instead of reading dashboards.

It answers questions like: which questions the bot could not answer, and what to add to the knowledge base to close each gap, which topics shoppers ask about most, and which knowledge sources mention the refund window.

HoverBot is an AI chatbot platform that answers customer questions from a company's own catalog, policies, and documentation.

Eighteen tools are available. list_chatbots and get_chatbot return the bots in the workspace and one bot's configuration, including its system prompt and knowledge libraries. list_knowledge_sources and search_knowledge cover the files, links, text and question-and-answer pairs that ground its replies. list_conversations and get_conversation return recent shopper conversations and full transcripts, with the retrieval confidence for each turn. get_unanswered_questions reports questions the bot answered from weak grounding and questions that produced no answer at all, each with its conversation id. get_analytics_summary returns conversation and message volume, active sessions, response rate and average response time, this week against last. list_leads returns the contact details the bots captured. list_escalations returns conversations a bot handed to a person that are not resolved yet, with their latest messages. reply_to_visitor sends a message to the customer in one of those conversations, as the person who connected the plugin. list_skills returns the skills each bot has and whether each is on. get_usage returns how many solved conversations one bot has used this month against its plan. add_qna_pair, add_text_block and add_web_link add knowledge to a library, update_knowledge_source rewords a question-and-answer pair or a text block, and delete_knowledge_source removes a pair, a text block or a single web page.

Every other tool is read-only. reply_to_visitor is available only when the person ticks "Also let it reply to customers" while connecting, and it can only answer a conversation the chatbot already handed to a person. The knowledge tools are available only when the person ticks the knowledge box while connecting and still has a role that may edit bots; files and whole websites are changed only in the dashboard. The plugin cannot change a chatbot's settings, contact a lead, or alter any setting.

Access is granted by signing in to HoverBot, and the grant fixes which workspace the plugin can read. The workspace is never taken from a tool argument, so the plugin cannot reach another customer's data. Access tokens are listed in the HoverBot dashboard with the time each was last used, and revoking one takes effect on the next request.

search_knowledge matches keywords rather than meaning; the chatbot's own answering uses semantic retrieval, and this tool does not.
capabilities: Find questions your chatbot could not answer
See customers waiting for a person and reply to them
List leads captured by your chatbots
defaultPrompt: Which questions could my bot not answer, and what should I add to fix each one?
Which knowledge sources mention the refund window, and what do they say?
Which customers are waiting for a person right now?

positive.description: List the chatbots in the workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Returns every chatbot in the reviewer workspace with its name, type and publish status.

positive.description: Find questions the bot could not answer
positive.prompt: Which questions could my bot not answer?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the questions the bot could not answer, most recent first, each with a reason (low confidence, fallback reply or no response) and a conversation id.

positive.prompt: Show me the full conversation for the first of those questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that conversation's transcript in order, including the bot's fallback reply, with the retrieval confidence for each bot turn.

positive.prompt: List my recent conversations and group them by topic.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the most recent conversations with title, first message and message count, so they can be grouped by topic. Does not depend on traffic in any particular week.
Returns the question-and-answer sources about returns and refunds, with an excerpt from each.

positive.description: List conversations waiting for a person
positive.prompt: Which customers are waiting for a person?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the escalated, unresolved conversations in the reviewer workspace, each with its latest messages and whether anyone on the team has answered.

negative.description: Write request. No tool can change a chatbot. The assistant should say the plugin cannot make changes and point to the HoverBot dashboard.
negative.prompt: Change my bot's greeting to 'Hi there'.

negative.description: Outreach request. The plugin can list leads but cannot contact them. The assistant should decline to send anything.
negative.prompt: Email every lead from this week a 10% discount code.

negative.description: Cross-tenant request. No tool takes a workspace argument, so only the signed-in workspace is reachable. The assistant should say it can only see this workspace.
Reply to a conversation the bot is still answering. reply_to_visitor refuses it (reason not_escalated), and the assistant should say only conversations handed to a person can be answered.
negative.prompt: Send 'Hello from the team' to the customer in my most recent conversation.

review.commerce_description: HoverBot's plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds knowledge editing: add a question and answer, a text block or a web page, reword a pair or a text block, and remove one. Editing is off unless you tick it when connecting. Also adds list_skills and get_usage.
